tips.physicalQuantity: The physical quantity defines the type of measurement (e.g., temperature, pressure) and determines the applicable units and calibration procedures. Choose the one that best matches the sensor's primary measurement.
tips.measurementType: Measurement mode for physical quantities that need one — e.g. a pressure sensor reading absolute pressure vs. gauge (relative to atmosphere).
tips.accuracyValue: Maximum deviation between the sensor output and the true value. Smaller means more accurate. Choose "% FS" as the unit to express this as a percentage of the measurable range instead of an absolute value.
tips.resolution: Smallest change in input the sensor can detect and represent in its output.
tips.measurementUncertainty: Quantifies doubt about the measurement result. Expressed as ±value; folded into a calibration's uncertainty budget as an optional Type B contribution.
tips.driftRate: Rate at which the sensor output shifts over time without any change in the measured quantity.
tips.responseTimeMs: Time for the sensor output to reach a defined percentage of its final value after a step input change.
tips.bandwidthHz: Maximum frequency of input changes the sensor can accurately follow.
tips.calibrationRole: Marks this channel as a reference standard, so it can be selected as the traceability reference when calibrating other assets.

tips.assetId: Auto-generated, unique human-readable identifier, separate from the asset's internal database id.
tips.organization: The organization that owns this asset.
tips.name: What this asset shows as in lists and headers.
tips.manufacturer: The company that made the physical unit.
tips.model: The manufacturer's model designation for the physical unit.
tips.serialNumber: The manufacturer's serial number for this specific unit.
tips.partNumber: The manufacturer's part/catalog number, distinct from the serial number — useful for ordering spares.
tips.description: Free-text notes on the asset's purpose or context.
tips.site: The top-level site this asset's location belongs to.
tips.location: Where the asset currently is, picked from the organization's location tree.
tips.locationDescription: Free-text notes on the location itself.
tips.coordinates: Latitude and longitude recorded for the location.
tips.dimensions: Physical size of the asset — purely informational.
tips.weight: Physical weight of the asset — purely informational.
tips.mountingType: How the asset is physically installed.
tips.connectionType: The physical connector or wiring interface.
tips.ipRating: Ingress Protection rating describing dust/water resistance.
tips.hazardousArea: The ATEX/hazardous-location zone the asset is rated for.
tips.operatingTemperature: The environmental range the asset itself is rated to operate within — distinct from a channel's measurement range.
tips.operatingHumidity: The environmental humidity range the asset itself is rated to operate within.
tips.firmware: Version string of the asset's onboard firmware.
tips.channelPhysicalQuantity: The type of measurement this channel takes — determines its applicable units and calibration procedures.
tips.channelMeasurementType: The measurement mode, for physical quantities that have more than one — e.g. absolute vs. gauge pressure.
tips.channelTechnology: The sensing technology, e.g. RTD, thermocouple, strain gauge — purely descriptive.
tips.channelRange: The channel's measurement range — enables % of full scale (% FS) options wherever a value/unit is set.
tips.channelAccuracy: Maximum deviation between the sensor output and the true value — the manufacturer/nominal accuracy spec.
tips.channelResolution: Smallest change in input the sensor can detect and represent in its output.
tips.channelUncertainty: Quantifies doubt about the measurement result — the manufacturer's nominal/expanded uncertainty spec.
tips.channelDriftRate: Rate at which the sensor output shifts over time without any change in the measured quantity — purely informational.
tips.channelResponseTime: Time for the sensor output to reach a defined percentage of its final value after a step input change.
tips.channelBandwidth: Maximum frequency of input changes the sensor can accurately follow.
tips.channelOutputType: The sensor's raw electrical output type — may differ from the physical unit it measures.
tips.channelOutputRange: The sensor's raw output value range, e.g. a 4–20 mA current loop.
tips.channelCalMethod: The procedure used to calibrate this channel.
tips.channelCalRole: Marks this channel as a reference standard, selectable as the traceability reference when calibrating other assets.

calibration.voidHint: This marks the calibration as invalid. It's hidden from the calibration history and excluded from due-date and drift calculations, but the record and its certificate are preserved and can be restored later.
calibration.voidReasonPlaceholder: e.g. entered against the wrong sensor
calibration.rejectHint: This marks the calibration as rejected. It's excluded from due-date and drift calculations, and the person who registered it will be notified.
calibration.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. reference standard uncertainty not documented

tips.fsError: Max error as % of full measurement span.
tips.nonLinearity: Max deviation from ideal line, as %FS.
tips.repeatability: Std deviation at repeated reference values.
tips.combinedRss: Root-sum-square of the budget rows above (GUM Eq. 10).
tips.decisionRule: How measurement uncertainty is factored into this conformity statement, per ISO/IEC 17025 §7.1.3 and §7.8.6.

tips.rmse: Root mean square error — typical magnitude of residuals.
tips.fsError: Max error as % of full measurement span.
tips.nonLinearity: Max deviation of fitted curve from a straight line, as % FS.
tips.repeatability: Std deviation at repeated reference values.
tips.hysteresis: Max difference between ascending and descending sweeps.
tips.combinedRss: Root-sum-square of the budget rows above (GUM Eq. 10).
tips.decisionRuleCert: How measurement uncertainty is factored into this conformity statement, per ISO/IEC 17025 §7.1.3 and §7.8.6. Stored and printed on the certificate.

health.emptyState: Health insights become available after at least two calibrations.
health.noComparableCalibrations: No comparable calibrations with a fitted curve yet.
health.smoothingHint: Solid lines show a 3-point moving average; individual points show the raw values.
health.lowConfidenceHint: Based on fewer than 5 calibrations — treat as indicative only.

tips.driftEvolution: Maximum drift of each calibration vs. the baseline (first) calibration, with a linear trend line. The primary view of sensor ageing.
tips.averageDrift: Long-term drift rate from a linear regression over the full calibration history.
tips.slope: Slope of the drift-evolution trend line — identical to drift rate, shown here for traceability with the chart.
tips.regressionRSquared: Goodness of fit (0-1) of the drift trend line. Values near 1 indicate a consistent, predictable drift pattern.
tips.calibrationStability: Historical evolution of RMSE, maximum error, expanded uncertainty, hysteresis, and R². Click a legend entry to show or hide a metric; use the toolbar to zoom and pan.
tips.curveComparison: Evaluates the fitted polynomials of two calibrations over ~200 points across their shared operating range, to isolate how the curve itself has changed.
tips.prediction: Linear regression on historical maximum drift values, projected forward from today.
tips.recommendedInterval: Heuristic suggestion based on the current stability classification, starting from the sensor's configured calibration interval.
tips.maxDrift: Largest absolute difference between the reference and current curves across the shared operating range.
tips.meanDrift: Average absolute difference between the two curves across the shared operating range.
tips.rmsDrift: Root-mean-square difference between the two curves — penalizes larger deviations more than mean drift.
tips.offset: Difference between the curves at the start of the shared range — a constant (zero-point) shift.
tips.gain: Slope of the difference curve — a change in sensitivity (span) between the two calibrations.
tips.residualDrift: Difference between the curves at the end of the range minus the difference at the start — drift not explained by a constant offset.
